[LSIG.1.4.1] `onset_rate` is the number of rising edges (false→true
transitions) per second within the sliding window:

$\mathit{onset\_rate} = \dfrac{N_{+}(t, W)}{\min(W, \mathit{elapsed})}$

where `N₊(t, W)` is the count of rising edges in the half-open window
`(t−W, t]` and `elapsed = t − t_first` ([LSER.19.7]).
